annotation_policy.scope: All article/provision citations representable by LawLink; chapter-only citations and bare act names have no API field and are excluded.
annotation_policy.identity: Supplied aliases: GPK=6, SK=8, GK=5, consumer law=984, court-information law=287; other explicit acts null.
annotation_policy.ranges: Read plural numeric hyphen ranges as inclusive from source context; preserve singular inserted labels verbatim. Currently unresolved parser ranges are counted as misses.
annotation_policy.paragraphs: Ordinal paragraph selectors identify individual provisions; each paragraph produces a link after paragraph omission. Identical projected links remain repeated.
annotation_policy.projection: Point overrides part when both are present; paragraph omitted, per CONTEXT.md.
annotation_policy.shared_tails: Compact coordinated branches ending in one explicit law form one reference span with branch-local targets.
annotation_policy.independence: Labels built from source review and the alias dictionary without production-parser predictions; regex inventory assists location only.

runtime.measurement: One complete-document TestClient request; warm direct pipeline measured separately.
